items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I received a wire from Mr. John Royal saying that, as I -- as the boat landed, to come right up to his office, and I went right to his office in Rockefeller, you know, Center, and they gave me, as I said, my contract.

ctx.x: And I think that was for the New York office to hear me, to see if they really wanted me, you see? And I broadcast from London to New York, and I immediately got notice to come on to New York. They sent me a contract for 20 weeks for NBC -- not NBC. It was the WEAF and WJZ -- to broadcast with them. See?

And I came right on back -- on my way on the ocean, I received a wire from Mr. John Royal saying that, as I -- as the boat landed, to come right up to his office, and I went right to his office in Rockefeller, you know, Center, and they gave me, as I said, my contract.
